visual_requirements.description: athletic beardless young man, one head, two arms, two legs, winged sandals, plain fully opaque long walnut tunic, herald wand with simple open figure-eight top
No visible supernatural emission; his herald wand and decisive movement convey the messenger and guide of souls
rocky bank of river Styx, dark underworld waters

source_claims.quote: Hermes plays the role of the psychopomp or "soul guide"—a conductor of souls into the afterlife.

statement.id: Hermes berperan sebagai pembimbing jiwa menuju alam kematian.
statement.en: Hermes serves as a guide of souls to the afterlife.

source_claims.quote: Hermes was depicted as either a handsome and athletic, beardless youth or as an older, bearded man, with winged boots and a herald's wand.

statement.id: Hermes digambarkan sebagai pemuda tanpa janggut atau pria tua berjanggut dengan sepatu bersayap dan tongkat pembawa pesan.
statement.en: Hermes is shown as a beardless youth or older bearded man with winged boots and a herald's wand.

source_claims.quote: One of his most famous regular roles was as a leader of souls to the river Styx in the underworld, where the boatman Charon would take them to Hades.

statement.id: Salah satu peran rutinnya yang termasyhur adalah menuntun jiwa ke Sungai Styx di dunia bawah, tempat juru perahu Charon membawa mereka ke Hades.
statement.en: One of his most famous regular roles was leading souls to the river Styx in the underworld, where the boatman Charon would take them to Hades.

source_claims.quote: In ancient Greek Archaic and Classical art, Hermes is depicted holding the kerykeion or caduceus staff (signifying his role as a herald, the stick is either cleft or with an open figure of 8 at the top), wearing winged sandals (symbolic of his role as a messenger), a long tunic or leopard skin, sometimes also a winged cap (petasos), and occasionally with a lyre.
source_claims.locator: How is Hermes Represented in Art?

statement.id: Dalam seni Yunani Arkais dan Klasik, Hermes digambarkan memegang tongkat kerykeion atau kaduseus (tanda perannya sebagai juru warta), bersandal bersayap (lambang perannya sebagai utusan), berjubah panjang atau kulit macan tutul, kadang bertopi bersayap (petasos), dan sesekali membawa lira.
statement.en: In Archaic and Classical Greek art Hermes is shown holding the kerykeion or caduceus staff (signifying his role as herald), wearing winged sandals (symbolic of his role as messenger), a long tunic or leopard skin, sometimes a winged cap (petasos), and occasionally a lyre.

source_claims.quote: Hermes' most distinctive attribute was the herald's wand (Greek kerykeion, Latin caduceus) but he was sometimes armed instead with a short sword.

statement.id: Atribut Hermes yang paling khas adalah tongkat juru warta (kerykeion dalam bahasa Yunani, caduceus dalam bahasa Latin), tetapi kadang ia dipersenjatai pedang pendek.
statement.en: Hermes' most distinctive attribute was the herald's wand (Greek kerykeion, Latin caduceus), though he was sometimes armed with a short sword instead.

artistic_choices: Palette, camera, age details, opaque clothing embellishment and unspecific staging are editorial choices, not additional source facts.
Dominance through close framing and foreshortening unless source documents scale.
No outward power added beyond documented domain; weather, light and debris remain physically grounded.
